questions.question: Describe how you would approach solution architecture for a telecommunications Quote-to-Cash implementation using Salesforce Industries Communications Cloud, Vlocity, and OmniStudio.
What experience do you have translating business requirements into solution designs, and how would you document decisions, assumptions, integrations, and implementation guidance for a delivery team?

Your background includes leading enterprise architecture and major infrastructure refresh projects. How would you use that experience to lead architecture discussions with a customer’s IT and business stakeholders?
How would you assess when to use standard Salesforce capabilities versus custom development on the Vlocity platform, particularly when customer requirements exceed platform limitations?
Describe your approach to designing integrations between Salesforce Communications Cloud, Salesforce APIs, and third-party systems involved in a telecom Quote-to-Cash process.

You have led multiple teams and coordinated vendors on enterprise systems. How would you guide an onsite-offshore team from approved solution architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment?
What artifacts would you create during the Salesforce project lifecycle to ensure requirements, solution design, development, testing, and deployment are traceable?
Describe your experience reviewing technical work, including code fixes, database changes, or automated processes. What would you look for when reviewing Salesforce, OmniStudio, or integration code?
How would you establish source-control practices and a deployment process for moving Salesforce configuration, custom code, and integration changes through higher environments?
Give an example from your experience managing a complex upgrade, migration, or conversion project. How did you prioritize work, manage risks, communicate status, and maintain service continuity?
